mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 1% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during FEDFUNDS < 1% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low UNRATE (< 4%) signals a strong labor market, contributing to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO and HOUST both exhibit YoY growth > 5%, it signals a supply-side boom, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and HOUST YoY growth > 5%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances with both INDPRO and HOUST YoY growth > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: during post-shock recovery, a monthly increase in RSAFS exceeding $10B signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 18-month rolling window during post-shock recovery periods.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high FEDFUNDS rate (> 2%) indicates tight monetary policy, contributing to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during FEDFUNDS > 2% periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a 0.5pp increase in UNRATE within 2 months signals labor market weakening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances with UNRATE increase > 0.5pp in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO exhibits YoY decline > 2% and HOUST shows YoY growth < 2%, it signals a supply-chain mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY decline > 2% and HOUST YoY growth < 2%
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.
